temporal_state_chain.observed: Ethan notices Gary has been working excessively long hours at the hospital, skipping meals and sleep. He invites Gary to a weekend retreat, but Gary declines because there is too much to do at the hospital.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary is dedicated but overworking to the point that his health is at risk, and that a break could help him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Gary's refusal confirms that his hospital obligations are currently overwhelming him and that he is not yet willing or able to step away.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan believes Gary is severely overcommitted to work and may be neglecting his health, but he is not ready to accept help in the form of a retreat.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Ethan wants to keep supporting Gary and find another way to encourage him to rest and protect his health.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During the retreat, Ethan observes Gary acting restless and avoiding discussions about work. When confronted, Gary says it is complicated and that he did not want to burden Ethan with his problems.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary is overworked because of hospital demands, though he may suspect there is more to the situation.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Gary's restless behavior, avoidance, and comment about not wanting to burden Ethan shift Ethan from a work-only explanation toward suspicion of deeper personal or emotional issues.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan believes Gary's overworking is likely tied to something more complicated than professional obligations, and that Gary may be hiding personal struggles to avoid burdening others.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Ethan wants to confront Gary gently and encourage him to open up, while making it clear he will not judge him.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Gary opens up about the pressures of managing a new department and the personal challenges he is facing. He accepts Ethan's suggestion to help him prioritize tasks and delegate responsibilities.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan suspects Gary's overwork stems from hidden personal and professional pressures, and he wants to understand what is really going on.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Gary's disclosure confirms that the overwork is driven by department pressures and personal challenges, and it shows that Gary is willing to accept help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan believes Gary's situation is understandable and that, with better task prioritization, delegation, and support, Gary can begin to find a healthier balance.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Ethan intends to help Gary organize his schedule, prioritize tasks, and find a better work-life balance.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Over the following months, Ethan regularly checks in with Gary. Gary reports progress and still mentions challenges, but says he is less overwhelmed and even had time for a movie last weekend.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary can improve with ongoing support and that prioritizing and delegating may help him regain balance.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Gary's reports and visible efforts confirm that he is actively making progress and benefiting from Ethan's support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan believes Gary is genuinely improving, becoming less overwhelmed, and moving toward a healthier work-life balance.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Ethan intends to continue checking in, offering encouragement, and supporting Gary through remaining challenges.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After a year, Gary appears to have successfully adjusted to a healthier work-life balance. Gary thanks Ethan, says he feels more in control, and seems capable of managing on his own.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary has been improving but may still benefit from support and regular check-ins.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Seeing Gary's sustained progress and sense of control changes Ethan's belief from Gary needing active support to Gary being able to manage independently.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan believes Gary has achieved a healthier work-life balance and no longer needs Ethan's active intervention.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Ethan intends to step back while letting Gary know he remains available if Gary ever needs him.
